bullpentalent-bullpen-talent:ashbyhq:e5d.title: Sr. Salesforce Systems Administrator
bullpentalent-bullpen-talent:ashbyhq:e5d.description: Job Title: Sr. Salesforce Systems Administrator Location: Mexico (Remote) Job Type: Full-time, Remote. Bullpen Talent is seeking a Sr. Salesforce Systems Administrator on behalf of our client: a leading, PE-backed, B2B AI technology company that helps teams plan, connect, and perform in the workplace. In this role, you'll shape the systems that power their go-to-market engine while partnering with leaders across Sales, Customer Success, Finance, and Revenue Operations. Day-to-day involves building scalable workflows, modernizing the AI-enabled revenue technology stack, and helping create a trusted data foundation that allows the business to move faster and make better decisions. Key Responsibilities - Oversee system architecture, platform governance, administration, and performance for a Salesforce instance supporting 250+ users. - Architect scalable Salesforce solutions that optimize revenue operations, sales forecasting, approval management, and customer lifecycle workflows. - Direct platform security, user access, single sign-on (SSO), multi-factor authentication (MFA), permission structures, and compliance initiatives. - Construct and refine Salesforce flows, system configurations, automated processes, and validation rules. - Manage the DealHub CPQ platform while driving continuous improvements across quote-to-cash operations. - Architect, maintain, and troubleshoot cross-platform integrations within the GTM ecosystem, including HubSpot, Gong, Accord, Gainsight, BigQuery, Fivetran, and prospective applications. - Evaluate, deploy, and streamline AI-powered workflows utilizing Model Context Protocol (MCP) connectors and modern automation tools. - Ensure high data integrity through governance frameworks, routine audits, validation strategies, and active monitoring. - Develop reports and executive dashboards that deliver clear visibility into pipeline, ARR, revenue forecasting, and key operational metrics. - Partner with cross-functional stakeholders across Sales, Customer Success, Finance, RevOps, and IT to convert business requirements into scalable technical solutions. - Head release management practices, platform enhancements, technical documentation, end-user training, and continuous improvement efforts. - Pinpoint opportunities where AI agents can automate repetitive operational tasks while upholding quality standards and governance. Must-have - Over 5 years of experience managing Salesforce platforms within a SaaS Go-To-Market or Revenue Operations setting. - Extensive background in configuring Salesforce settings, system automation, security frameworks, and overall platform governance. - Direct, practical experience utilizing enterprise quote-to-cash systems like DealHub, Salesforce CPQ, or comparable solutions. - Proven track record of designing and maintaining enterprise-level integrations, webhooks, and REST APIs. - Demonstrated history of establishing scalable frameworks for reporting, validation, and data governance. - Solid grasp of Salesforce architectural principles, Apex basics, validation rules, and Salesforce Flows. - Skilled in assisting executive leadership through strategic initiatives and high-level operational reporting. - Talent for translating complex technical ideas into clear, accessible language for business partners. - High level of ownership with a proven ability to prioritize, execute effectively, and drive ongoing system enhancements. - Proficient in AI capabilities—including prompt engineering, evaluating AI-driven workflows, managing AI assistants, and recognizing automation possibilities while preserving governance and human supervision. Why Join? - Work within a culture of trust, respect, growth, and impact. - Be part of a performance-based company that hires on merit and values building at light speed. - Opportunity to work with leading AI technology and serve as an Agentic AI early adopter.

crestoperations-crestoperations:lever:f8.title: Machine Operator I (Weekends)
crestoperations-crestoperations:lever:f8.description: Come join our team at DIS-TRAN Steel! Our people – not our machinery - are our biggest assets. DIS-TRAN Steel’s leadership team lives by our company values, modeling our culture of respect and integrity each day. We're a team that likes to have fun, but we also know how to get stuff done. DIS-TRAN Steel, located in Eunice, LA, is looking for experienced Machine Operators to join our team on Weekends. The Machine Operator must be capable of operating machines in a steel plant. This individual must possess the ability to read a tape measure; must possess basic math aptitude. The Machine Operator will safely operate CNC machinery (drill, saw, etc.). This individual will perform daily preventative maintenance on machines.
responsibilities: Operates CNC machines.
Measures dimensions of finished steel structures to ensure conformance to specifications, using precision measuring instruments, templates, and fixtures.
Mounts, installs, aligns, and secures tools, attachments, fixtures, and workpieces on machines, using hand tools and precision measuring instruments.
Listens to machines during operation to detect sounds such as those made by dull cutting tools or excessive vibration and adjust machines to compensate for problems.
Adjusts machine feed and speed, change cutting tools, or adjust machine controls.
Stops machines to remove finished workpieces or to change tooling, setup, or workpiece placement, according to required machining sequences.
Lifts workpieces to machines manually or with hoists or cranes.
Modifies cutting programs to account for problems encountered during operation and saves modified programs.
Inserts control instructions into machine control units to start operation.
qualifications: High School Diploma or equivalent preferred.
Ability to read and interpret typed reports and schedules required.
Ability to interpret blueprints required.
Ability to read a tape measure required.
Certifications or prior experience using moving machinery, such as cranes, preferred.
Basic math aptitude required.
Must complete on-site training and demonstrate safe operation of machinery.

flagshippioneeringinc-flagshippioneering.title: Senior Machine Learning Scientist
flagshippioneeringinc-flagshippioneering.description: Position Summary: We are looking for a Machine Learning Scientist to build AI and machine learning systems that turn complex biological data into actionable scientific insight. You will work at the intersection of ML, genomics, causal biology, and target discovery. The role includes building models, agentic AI workflows, systems that help automate analysis, reasoning, and decision support, and AI assisted tools that help connect genotype, cell state, perturbation, phenotype, and disease mechanism. This is a hands-on role for someone who enjoys writing clear, reliable code, uses modern AI tools to move faster, and wants their work to shape real biological and therapeutic decisions. Responsibilities: Build ML models for genomic, single-cell, perturbation, and phenotype data. Develop agentic AI workflows that help scientists analyze data, test hypotheses, and make better decisions. Use AI coding tools to accelerate development while keeping code reliable, readable, tested, and reproducible. Train and fine tune foundation models, language models, and representation learning methods for target discovery. Model relationships between genotype, cell state, perturbation response, causal biology, and disease. Collaborate closely with computational scientists, experimental biologists, software engineers, and target discovery teams. Communicate results clearly, including model assumptions, limitations, and next steps. Qualifications: You do not need to meet every item to apply. Strong candidates may come from academia, industry, open-source work, or hands-on research. PhD, Master’s degree, or equivalent experience in machine learning, computer science, computational biology, genomics, bioinformatics, statistics, engineering, or a related field. Strong Python coding skills and experience building practical Deep Learning ML systems. Experience using AI coding tools, coding assistants, LLM-based workflows, or agentic development tools. Experience training, evaluating, or applying ML models to complex real-world data. Depth in one or more of: biomedical foundation models, agentic AI, Perturb-seq, single-cell genomics, genotype–phenotype modeling, causal inference, perturbation modeling, or large-scale biological datasets. Evidence of technical depth through papers, thesis work, open-source projects, industry projects, or substantial hands-on applied research. Values and Behaviors: Encourage respectful disagreement and cultivate open-minded, ego-free interactions to continuously push each other towards excellence Seek out diverse perspectives; practice active listening and genuine curiosity to ensure all contributions are valued, regardless of source Recognize the impact of your behavior, language and attitudes, and strive for balanced, meaningful exchanges that enhance mutual growth and understanding in all interactions Use a company-first mindset to guide decision-making; prioritize team over individual success Take calculated risks and challenge convention in the quest for exceptional outcomes About Quotient: Quotient Therapeutics is a privately-held, early stage company developing breakthrough medicines informed by natural somatic genetic diversity present in patients. Through our work in somatic genomics, we are forging a new status quo for biopharma research and development across a broad pipeline of internal and partnered programs. The company was founded by Flagship Pioneering, an innovative enterprise that conceives, creates, resources, and grows first-in-category life sciences companies. Flagship Pioneering has created over 100 groundbreaking companies over the past twenty years, all of which are pioneering novel and proprietary biological, industrial, and engineering approaches to solve major needs in human health and sustainability. These companies include Moderna (MRNA), Generate Biomedicines, Sana Biotechnology (SANA), Tessera Therapeutics, Evelo Biosciences (EVLO), Indigo Agriculture, Seres Therapeutics (MCRB), and Syros Pharmac

jobgether-jobgether:lever:6674c8a7-3006-.title: Agentic Engineer Level
jobgether-jobgether:lever:6674c8a7-3006-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an Agentic Engineer Level based in India. This is an opportunity to build and scale production-grade AI agents that automate complex customer and business workflows. You will combine strong software engineering fundamentals with prompt engineering and API-driven automation to create reliable agentic experiences. The role involves designing LLM prompts, building workflows, integrating external systems, and ensuring autonomous agents perform consistently in real-world scenarios. You will work with modern no-code and low-code automation capabilities while applying robust engineering principles behind the scenes. Reliability, performance, cost efficiency, observability, and fault tolerance will be central to the solutions you deliver. You will collaborate closely with Product, QA, and Delivery teams in a fast-moving environment focused on bringing AI solutions into production. This role offers the opportunity to contribute directly to the evolution of enterprise AI and intelligent workflow automation. Design, develop, and refine high-quality prompts for LLM-based agents, with a focus on reliable behavior and consistent task execution. Build and scale agentic tools and workflows using a no-code automation platform comparable to Workato, Zapier, or n8n. Integrate internal and external REST APIs, managing authentication, data mapping, webhooks, JSON payloads, and error handling. Develop production-ready agent workflows with appropriate unit testing, debugging, troubleshooting, and validation processes. Apply resilient engineering patterns such as retries, timeouts, idempotency, lazy loading, and robust non-happy-path handling. Optimize agent workflows for performance, scalability, cost efficiency, reliability, and fault tolerance. Identify and resolve workflow failures and integration issues, ensuring dependable operation across different scenarios. Collaborate with Product, QA, Delivery, and other technical stakeholders to design, test, and launch production-grade agentic solutions. Contribute to engineering best practices and continuously improve the quality, maintainability, and scalability of AI-powered workflows. Support monitoring and observability of deployed solutions, identifying opportunities to improve production performance and reliability. Requirements: 4–7 years of professional experience as a Software Development Engineer, Software Engineer, or in a comparable engineering role. Strong software engineering fundamentals and the ability to translate technical requirements into reliable, scalable solutions. Solid understanding of prompt engineering and LLM behavior , including the ability to design prompts that produce consistent and useful agent responses. Hands-on experience working with REST APIs, webhooks, JSON-based integrations , authentication, and data mapping. Strong experience with unit testing, debugging, troubleshooting, and identifying root causes of technical issues. Understanding of resilient system design and engineering patterns, including retries, timeouts, idempotency, fault tolerance, and handling non-happy-path scenarios. Ability to think systematically about reliability, performance, scalability, and cost when designing automated workflows. Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively across Product, QA, Delivery, and engineering teams. A proactive, analytical, and solution-oriented approach to solving complex technical problems. Experience with no-code or low-code automation platforms is a plus. Exposure to agentic AI, conversational AI, workflow orchestration, or intelligent automation systems is desirable. Familiarity with production observability and monitoring practices is an advantage. jobgether-jobgether:lever:9d332cf1-3a2c-.title: Senior Software Engineer (Data)
jobgether-jobgether:lever:9d332cf1-3a2c-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Software Engineer (Data) based in United Arab Emirates. This is an opportunity to join a lean, autonomous engineering team building products that help organizations better understand and optimize cloud data costs. You’ll play a key role in designing and delivering new capabilities across backend systems, data engineering, visualization, and cost-management workflows. The position offers meaningful ownership, with the opportunity to shape technical direction and influence the product roadmap. You’ll work closely with experienced engineers and founding team members in a fast-moving environment where pragmatic decisions and customer impact matter. From data pipelines and transformation models to resilient application components, your work will directly improve the product experience. The role is ideal for a self-directed engineer who enjoys solving complex problems, moving quickly, and owning features from concept through release. You’ll also have the flexibility and autonomy of a distributed team that values collaboration, continuous learning, and sustainable ways of working. Design and build new product capabilities focused on data cost management, including forecasting, anomaly detection, cost allocation, and related workflows. Develop reliable and reusable backend and data-engineering solutions that surface actionable insights for customers. Build data pipelines and transformation models that support new product capabilities and identify opportunities for optimization. Create and improve data visualization features that communicate performance, query timing, efficiency, and other important metrics clearly. Develop resilient, reusable UI components that contribute to a smooth and intuitive product experience. Improve application reliability, scalability, and performance through thoughtful engineering practices and system design. Own features end to end, from identifying problems and shaping requirements through technical design, implementation, testing, and release. Evaluate technical and product tradeoffs to prioritize high-impact solutions and deliver meaningful customer value efficiently. Collaborate closely with engineers and senior stakeholders through clear proposals, documentation, code reviews, testing, and effective communication. Contribute to a culture of pragmatic execution, continuous improvement, and strong engineering quality. Requirements 5+ years of relevant software engineering experience, with strong expertise in backend development and data engineering. Strong working knowledge of Python, FastAPI, PostgreSQL, dbt, Dagster, and Snowflake . Solid understanding of system design and the ability to develop scalable, reliable technical solutions. Experience building data pipelines, transformation workflows, backend services, and data-driven product capabilities. Strong written and verbal English communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively in a distributed environment. Demonstrated ability to work independently, take ownership, and remain accountable for outcomes from initial concept through delivery. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with sound judgment when balancing speed, technical depth, and customer impact. Comfortable working in a fast-moving and evolving environment where priorities and requirements may change. Strong collaboration skills and a commitment to readable, maintainable code, clear documentation, and thorough testing. A proactive, curious, and positive approach to engineering, with genuine enthusiasm for solving challenging problems. Familiarity with FinOps, cloud infrastructure cost management, data-warehouse management, or observability is a plus. Previous experience working in an early-stage startup or similarly lean engineering environment is advantageous. Benefits Base salary of up to $180,000 CAD , plus additional compens

This is a senior, high-impact leadership opportunity focused on accelerating enterprise growth through strategic partnerships and complex commercial relationships. You will help expand the organization’s presence among leading brands, agencies, and ecosystem partners across the creator economy. Working closely with product, marketing, operations, and executive leadership, you’ll translate market insights into differentiated growth strategies. jobgether-jobgether:lever:fe7a9fb7-3170-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior QA Automation Engineer based in United Arab Emirates. This is a senior-level quality engineering role focused on protecting the reliability, correctness, and scalability of critical payment flows. You’ll combine exploratory testing with an automation-first approach across APIs, distributed services, and external financial integrations. The role offers ownership of end-to-end quality, from test strategy and automation through production debugging and release readiness. You’ll work closely with backend engineers and product teams to define acceptance criteria, improve testability, and strengthen quality gates. The environment is modern and cloud-based, with Java, Spring Boot, REST APIs, React, PHP, AWS, and Playwright at its core. You’ll have the opportunity to influence engineering standards while working on a high-impact fintech platform used for global payments and financial operations. This is an ideal opportunity for a technically strong QA professional who enjoys solving complex problems and building scalable, reliable testing practices. Own end-to-end quality for critical payment journeys, including deposits, payouts, reconciliation, and other business-critical transaction scenarios. Design and execute API-first test strategies covering REST, JSON, HTTP, and complex transaction lifecycles. Build, maintain, and improve automated API and selective UI test suites using Playwright, RestAssured, or comparable frameworks. Develop reusable automation components such as API clients, test data builders, and supporting utilities. Test integrations with external providers, including payment processors and Open Banking services, with particular attention to asynchronous callbacks, polling, retries, and failure scenarios. Investigate production incidents, reproduce defects, analyze logs, database records, and API traces, and contribute to root-cause analysis. Collaborate with backend engineers to improve system testability and work with product teams to establish clear acceptance criteria. Contribute to release quality gates, regression testing strategies, smoke tests, and pre-release validation within CI/CD pipelines. Identify risks across distributed payment systems and proactively strengthen testing coverage, reliability, and engineering quality standards. Explore AI-assisted QA and automation techniques where they can improve testing efficiency and effectiveness. Requirements Proven experience in QA engineering, test automation, or a closely related software quality role, with strong ownership of complex systems. Hands-on experience testing REST APIs, including HTTP, JSON, request/response validation, and API-driven workflows. Strong understanding of backend systems, distributed services, and software integration patterns. Practical experience with test automation frameworks such as Playwright, RestAssured, or similar tools. Ability to diagnose technical issues using application logs, databases, API traces, and other debugging tools. Understanding of asynchronous systems and transaction patterns, including callbacks, queues, polling, retries, and failure handling. Previous experience in payments, fintech, or another environment involving highly reliable transactional systems is strongly valued. Experience working with CI/CD pipelines and integrating automated quality checks into software delivery processes. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to identify risks beyond individual feature requirements. SQL and data-validation skills are an advantage. Experience with distributed systems is a plus. Familiarity with prompt engineering or AI-powered tools for QA and test automation is beneficial.
